title: VA Open Data (data.va.gov) and NCVAS Veteran Statistics
questions: number of veterans by state (VetPop projection)
veterans by period of service or age group in a state
veterans by county or congressional district
VA expenditures by state, county or congressional district
disability compensation recipients by county and rating
annual disability compensation dollars by state

manual.how: Open the dataset page (https://www.data.va.gov/d/<id>), choose Export > CSV, and upload the file; or open the CSV links in INSTRUCTIONS.md. GDX workbooks: download https://www.va.gov/vetdata/docs/GDX/GDX_FY<yy>.xlsx and upload it. NCVAS publishes the VetPop tables as workbooks at https://www.va.gov/vetdata/veteran_population.asp.

cache.why: Queries are small; datasets are republished without notice. data/ is reused within a run.

redistribution.why: VA data are U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105); NCVAS asks to be cited as the source.

citation: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, National Center for Veterans Analysis and Statistics, {dataset}, data.va.gov and va.gov/vetdata, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which fiscal year? VetPop2023 gives one value per September 30 from 2023 to 2053; years after 2023 are projections, not counts. Default: the current fiscal year's September 30 value, labeled a projection.
All veterans, or a period of service, age group or sex? VetPop tables split by sex and age or period of service only; totals are sums of the rows.
aliases: National Center for Veterans Analysis and Statistics
